lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p33 - Talk about the pictures. Make predictions.

details: Talk about the pictures activates prior knowledge. Students look at the canteen scene and identify the food and characters to predict what the story is about.
Look for recognition of the "canteen" setting and pointing to the food items (chicken, pasta, fish), as well as students making predictions about the story.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p33 - Listen to the story.

details: Listen to the story develops narrative comprehension. Students listen to the dialogue to understand the sequence of events and the importance of saying "please".
Look for attentive listening and reaction to the moment the boy forgets to say "please" in the second panel.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p33 - Act it out.

details: Act it out builds confidence and fluency. Students role-play the canteen scene, practising the question "What would you like?" and the polite response "I'd like..., please."
Look for clear speech, use of "please" and "thank you," and appropriate gestures (serving food, holding a tray).

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p95 - Join the dots.

details: Join the dots reinforces shape recognition and fine motor skills. Students connect the dots to reveal the 3D shapes (cone hats, sphere decoration, cylinder cake).
Look for neat lines connecting the dots to form the correct geometric shapes.

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p95 - Colour the cones.

details: Colour the cones assesses visual classification. Students identify the specific shape (cone) in the party scene and colour only those items.
Look for accurate identification of the party hats as cones and colouring them, while leaving the other shapes blank (or different colours).

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p95 - 3. Find and name the 3D shapes.

details: Find and name connects the visual form to the vocabulary. Students point to the objects in the picture (cake, ball, cups) and say the correct mathematical term.
Look for correct naming: "The cake is a cylinder," "The ball is a sphere," "The hats are cones."

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p96 - Look and match.

details: Look and match develops logical thinking and pattern recognition. Students analyse the sequence of shapes (e.g., Sphere, Sphere, Cone...) and draw a line to the shape that comes next.
Look for correct identification of the pattern rule and matching to the correct next shape (e.g., connecting the first row to the Sphere).

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p96 - Draw a new pattern.

details: Draw a new pattern allows for creative application of mathematical concepts. Students create their own sequence using the 3D shapes (e.g., cylinder, cone, cylinder, cone).
Look for a repeating logical sequence of shapes drawn in the empty box.
